items.text: Seattle QB: Sam Darnold (quad/ribs) ruled OUT; Drew Lock (right elbow, limited) starts, as the schedule lists. Also DNP - LT Charles Cross (ankle), WR Rashid Shaheed (knee), DT Leonard Williams (stinger), DT Brandon Pili, LB Connor O'Toole; limited - G Quenton Nelson, G Anthony Bradford, LB Uchenna Nwosu, RB Velus Jones.

Arizona: Gardner Minshew starts (Carson Beck QB2; Jacoby Brissett DNP, not injury-related, reportedly being traded to Baltimore). DNP - OT Jayden Williams (knee), RB Bam Knight (concussion), OL Jon Gaines II (ankle), plus rest days for S Budda Baker, LB Josh Sweat, G Isaac Seumalo, C Hjalte Froholdt; limited - WR Michael Wilson (ribs), DL Walter Nolen III, G Isaiah Adams. RB Jeremiyah Love (IR), WR Kendrick Bourne (season), OT Paris Johnson Jr., RB James Conner out.
